lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig. This is my little brother, George. This is Mummy Pig. And this is Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 我是小猪佩奇。这是我的弟弟乔治，这是猪妈妈，这是猪爸爸。

lines.en: My Cousin Chloé. Peppa and George are playing in the garden.
lines.zh: 我的表姐克洛伊。佩奇和乔治在花园里玩。

lines.en: To me, George! You threw the ball too hard.
lines.zh: 传给我，乔治！你把球扔得太用力了。

lines.en: George, so the rules say I win. Now it's my turn. I win again!
lines.zh: 乔治，按规则算我赢了。现在轮到我了。我又赢啦！

lines.en: Peppa, George, today your big Cousin Chloé is coming to visit.
lines.zh: 佩奇，乔治，今天你们的表姐克洛伊要来做客。

lines.en: Chloé! George, Chloé is a big girl like me.
lines.zh: 克洛伊！乔治，克洛伊是像我一样的大孩子。

lines.en: So don't be sad if she finds you too little to play with. Oh, I'm sure Chloé will play with both of you.
lines.zh: 所以如果她觉得你太小、不想跟你玩，你们也别难过。哦，我相信克洛伊会跟你们两个一起玩的。

lines.en: Chloé's here! Auntie Pig has brought Chloé to spend the day at Peppa's house.
lines.zh: 克洛伊来啦！猪阿姨把克洛伊带来，在佩奇家玩一天。

lines.en: Chloé is Peppa and George's cousin. Chloé is a bit older than Peppa and George. Hello, Chloé. Hello, Peppa. Hello, George. See you later.
lines.zh: 克洛伊是佩奇和乔治的表姐。克洛伊比佩奇和乔治大一点。你好，克洛伊。你好，佩奇。你好，乔治。待会儿见。

lines.en: Do you want to play a game? Yes, let's play catch. Peppa loves playing catch.
lines.zh: 你想玩游戏吗？想，我们玩接球吧。佩奇喜欢玩接球。

lines.en: Do you still play catch? That's a game for little children. Oh, we only play catch because George likes it. Okay, let's play it for George.
lines.zh: 你们还在玩接球吗？那是小孩子玩的游戏。哦，我们玩接球是因为乔治喜欢。好吧，那就为乔治玩一次。

lines.en: Do you play it with the proper rules or the baby rules? Proper rules.
lines.zh: 你们是按正式规则玩，还是按小孩子规则玩？正式规则。

lines.en: I'll start. Peppa, you're it! Catch me if you can! Peppa is it. She has to chase Chloé and George.
lines.zh: 我先来。佩奇，你来抓！有本事就抓到我！佩奇来抓人。她得去追克洛伊和乔治。

lines.en: Can't catch me! George, I'm going to easily catch you. You're so little.
lines.zh: 抓不到我！乔治，我轻轻松松就能抓到你。你太小了。

lines.en: That's not fair! You're helping George. That's because he's little. Do you want me to help you? No, I don't need help. I'm a big girl like you. Come on, then.
lines.zh: 这不公平！你在帮乔治。因为他还小呀。你要我帮你吗？不用，我不需要帮忙。我是像你一样的大孩子。那来吧。

lines.en: Peppa, try and catch us! Can't catch us! Can't catch us!
lines.zh: 佩奇，来抓我们呀！抓不到我们！抓不到我们！

lines.en: This is a silly game. Can we play something else? Okay, I know a really good game for big children. It's called Sly Fox.
lines.zh: 这个游戏真没意思。我们能玩点别的吗？好吧，我知道一个特别适合大孩子玩的游戏。它叫「狡猾的狐狸」。

lines.en: Sly Fox! I want to play Sly Fox. What is it?
lines.zh: 狡猾的狐狸！我要玩狡猾的狐狸。那是什么？

lines.en: One person is the sly fox, and the others creep up on them. Me! Me! I want to be the sly fox.
lines.zh: 一个人当狡猾的狐狸，其他人悄悄靠近他。我！我！我要当狡猾的狐狸。

lines.en: Peppa is the sly fox. While her back is turned, the others creep up on her. But if Peppa turns and sees someone move, they have to go back to the start.
lines.zh: 佩奇当狡猾的狐狸。她背过身去的时候，其他人悄悄靠近她。但如果佩奇转过身看见有人在动，那个人就得退回起点。

lines.en: George, I saw you move. Back to the start!
lines.zh: 乔治，我看见你动了。退回起点！

lines.en: Got you! I win! You moved before I was ready. The rules say I can move when I like, don't they, George?
lines.zh: 抓到你啦！我赢了！我还没准备好你就动了。规则说我什么时候想动就什么时候动，对吧，乔治？

lines.en: George. Now it's Chloé's turn to be the sly fox.
lines.zh: 乔治。现在轮到克洛伊当狡猾的狐狸了。

lines.en: Peppa and George must stay very still. Peppa, I saw you move. Back to the start!
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治必须一动不动。佩奇，我看见你动了。退回起点！

lines.en: It's not fair! You look too long. The rules say I can look as long as I want. Back to the start!
lines.zh: 这不公平！你看得太久了。规则说我想看多久就看多久。退回起点！

lines.en: George is the winner! Can we play a different game? Yes, but as long as it's a grown-up game.
lines.zh: 乔治赢啦！我们能玩个别的游戏吗？可以，但得是大孩子的游戏。

lines.en: I know, let's play my favorite game. It's very grown up. George, do you know what Peppa's favorite game is?
lines.zh: 我知道，我们来玩我最喜欢的游戏吧。那可是非常成熟的。乔治，你知道佩奇最喜欢的游戏是什么吗？

lines.en: Peppa's favorite game is jumping up and down in muddy puddles.
lines.zh: 佩奇最喜欢的游戏是在泥坑里跳上跳下。

lines.en: George, if you jump in puddles, you must wear your boots. I've brought some boots for you, too, Chloé.
lines.zh: 乔治，如果你要跳泥坑，就必须穿上靴子。克洛伊，我也给你带了一双靴子。

lines.en: I'm too grown up to jump in muddy puddles. Oh, so am I.
lines.zh: 我太大了，不跳泥坑了。哦，我也是。

lines.en: George loves jumping in muddy puddles. Secretly, Peppa would love to jump in the puddle, but she wants to look grown up.
lines.zh: 乔治喜欢在泥坑里跳。佩奇心里其实很想跳，可她想显得像个大孩子。

lines.en: I hear there's some puddle jumping going on. Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig love jumping in muddy puddles. It does look fun. Yes, it does!
lines.zh: 我听说有人在跳泥坑呢。猪妈妈和猪爸爸喜欢在泥坑里跳。看起来确实很有意思。是的，确实很有意思！
